name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2491: tv/organ_matrix.py measures 44 surfaces against the four organs instead of filling the table in. Two states were not enough: 9 cells are MISNAMED, where the organ is watching the thing under another name, which is how the table he was shown came to look empty; and console_doctor has no report at all so its column is UNKNOWN rather than absent. Third instance today of one root cause, disjoint vocabularies. The MISNAMED guard was vacuous on its first cut and passed while every such cell collapsed to ABSENT.
